Package index

Mortality (SIM)

Mortality Information System: general, fetal, infant, maternal and external-cause deaths.

load_mortality()
Load Brazilian mortality data from the SIM system via DATASUS

Live births (SINASC)

Live Birth Information System.

load_births()
Loads birth data of newborns from Brazil provided by DATASUS

Hospital admissions (SIH)

Hospital Information System of SUS: AIH records, professional services and rejected AIHs.

load_hospital_admissions()
Loads hospital admission data from Brazil provided by DATASUS (SIHSUS)

Outpatient procedures (SIA)

Outpatient Information System of SUS: ambulatory production and APAC sub-datasets.

load_outpatient_procedures()
Loads outpatient procedure data from Brazil provided by 'SIASUS' (Ambulatory Information System)

Hospital beds (CNES)

Monthly hospital beds from the National Registry of Health Establishments (CNES-LT).

load_hospital_beds()
Load monthly data on hospital beds from Brazil's National Health Facilities Registry

Oncology cases (PO)

Oncology Panel (PAINEL-Oncologia).

load_oncology_case()
Loads oncology case data from Brazil provided by DATASUS

Vaccination (SI-PNI)

National Immunization Program Information System.

load_vaccines()
Load Brazilian vaccination data from the SI-PNI system via DATASUS

Utilities

Helpers for DATASUS file formats and package documentation.

dbc2dbf_wrapper()
Decompress a DBC (compressed DBF) file
